root.label: Alani Bankhead says she will not drop out of Montana Senate race

events.label: Alani Bankhead says she will not drop out of Montana Senate race

slots.name: withdrawal status
slots.sentence: “I’m a person of faith. If a lightning bolt from God struck me and was like, ‘Alani, get out of the race,’ sure,” Bankhead told POLITICO when asked if anything would change her mind. Otherwise, she said there’s “absolutely nothing.”
